presets.name: Lofi Dusk
presets.prompt: dark editorial dusk portrait, warm peach skin highlights, glowing rim light, near-black bokeh, restrained DSLR flash, fine analog film grain and soft halation
presets.negative_prompt: plastic skin, identity change, extra limbs, altered product, text, logo, watermark, oversharpening, cartoon rendering
variations: stronger flash contrast with gentle bloom
quality_rules: keep source product and logos unchanged

presets.name: Sun-Kissed
presets.prompt: warm natural golden-hour portrait, luminous but realistic skin, soft sun flare, radiant highlights, clean warm editorial color grade
presets.negative_prompt: orange skin, burned highlights, identity change, added objects, text, logo, watermark, artificial plastic smoothing

presets.name: Y2K Digicam
presets.prompt: authentic early-2000s compact digital camera aesthetic, direct flash, saturated colors, slight low-resolution softness, candid nightlife energy
presets.negative_prompt: modern studio lighting, face distortion, added text, logo, watermark, overdone glitch, altered product
variations: clean direct flash with modest color pop
stronger flash with playful digicam grain

presets.name: Luxury Product
presets.prompt: premium editorial product photograph, controlled soft directional light, precise material detail, refined contrast, minimal luxury campaign finish
presets.negative_prompt: changed product shape, altered packaging, changed logo, fake text, clutter, watermark, unrealistic reflections
variations: soft side-light with deep premium shadows
bright clean studio finish with restrained contrast
